50.Log:
Kunimitsu Update Support
-A feature has been added that detects the installed Steam version TEKKEN 8 and automatically sets the path.

(If no path is set, it automatically searches for the Steam version's path.)

- Thanks to this, desync no longer occurs due to Kunimitsu's mask.
- An exception list has been added to the Editor. You can pass exceptions to the Loader through this.
- Please check the Discord Server for more details.
